reviews.text: I took me and my son and wife to this Awesome pool and they even provided life jackets to all the kids and adults! The life guards were on point with everyone in the pool. It was pretty fun and we plan on coming back Real Soon! Thanks Everyone! P.S it's $2 per person to get in.
reviews.author: Oscar Williams

reviews.text: Only $1 to get in. It wasn't very packed when we went. Staff is friendly. Bring a cooler if you want snacks there is no food served. Water is perfect temp not to cold. It's a basic pool for very shallow water and kid slides go to Bedford splash or hurst aquatic center.
reviews.author: Esperanza Garcia

reviews.text: Good size and clean pool ranging from 2ft to 11ft. Couple if benches with cabanas. However the restrooms are unclean hence 4 stars.
reviews.author: Jessica P

reviews.text: Perfect place to go for swimming and sunning in the local community
reviews.author: Christina Eschbacher

reviews.text: This is our go-to spot in the summer! We love Roy Savage Pool! The summer staff have always been wonderful. Clean, fun, no-frills. Cheap entry ($2/each - they also accept cards). The perfect spot to spend a summer afternoon. We cannot wait for it to open back up again for this summer! ☀️
reviews.author: Marguerite Allen

reviews.text: Have visited 3 times and headed for a 4th today. Perfect for just a nice swim. Staff is great and for $1 i make the trip from south fort worth because it has a very nice vibe and my kids have plenty of space to splash as they are learning to swim. Yes chlorine is a bit much but for a community pool id expect it to be a little higher than an at residential pool
reviews.author: She is Sunshyne

reviews.text: Now that my kids have grown out of the splash pad phase this is my go to pool where you just actually chill and swim in the pool. My first time back here since I was in 3rd grade and it still has the same comfy vibe here! The best thing about it is that it's only a $1! You cant beat find this price anywhere here in the HEB. I definitely recommend this place for kids that know how to swim.
reviews.author: Taniela “Tani” Vake

reviews.text:
Small quite pool, free floaties already blown up, and free life vests for kids to wear.
Very inexpensive to gain admission.
Plenty of covered tables and a clean place.
Love the fact that we can bring our own food and drinks.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Holt
